item.title: How The Duggar Family’s TV Empire Unraveled
item.description: The Duggars became reality-TV stars through 19 Kids and Counting, but revelations involving eldest son Josh led TLC to cancel the series in 2015. Years later, Counting On also ended, and Josh was convicted of receiving child sexual abuse material and sentenced to more than 12 years in federal prison.

item.title: Two Deaths At The Same Mansion Days Apart
item.description: Six-year-old Max Shacknai suffered a fatal fall at his father’s Coronado mansion in 2011. The next day, Rebecca Zahau was found dead at the same property. Authorities ruled Max’s death accidental and Zahau’s a suicide, though her family has long disputed that conclusion.

item.title: The Last Man With Savannah Said She Simply Left
item.description: Savannah Spurlock vanished after leaving a Lexington bar with three men in 2019. David Sparks told police she had left his home on her own, but months later her remains were found buried on his family’s property. He eventually admitted killing her and was sentenced to 50 years.

item.title: She Was Left Injured For Six Days Before Help Came
item.description: Melissa Platt was found barely alive during a welfare check in October 2008 after going days without medical attention. She died from her injuries that December. Her family has long alleged her boyfriend was responsible, but no one has been charged in her death.

item.title: His Mother Said He Was Safe Then He Vanished
item.description: Six-year-old Timmothy Pitzen vanished in 2011 after a three-day trip with his mother, Amy. She was later found dead in a motel, leaving a note claiming Timmothy was safe with people who loved him and would never be found. Fifteen years later, he remains missing.

item.title: The House Fire That Hid Melissa Lamesch’s Murder
item.description: Melissa Lamesch was found dead inside her burning Illinois home just two days before she was due to give birth. An autopsy showed she had been strangled before the fire. Matthew Plote, the father of her unborn child, was later convicted and sentenced to life.

item.title: Her Newborn Was Found Alive After Savanna Vanished
item.description: Eight-months-pregnant Savanna Greywind disappeared from her Fargo apartment building in 2017 after visiting an upstairs neighbor. Her newborn daughter was later found alive, while Savanna’s body was recovered from the Red River. Brooke Crews later pleaded guilty to murder.
